title: Prompted Which houseplants survive in a north-facing room?

safeHtmlItem.html:
North-facing rooms get indirect light only, so pick low-light tolerant plants:

  • Snake plant – thrives on neglect, water every 2–3 weeks.
  • ZZ plant – glossy leaves, stores water in its rhizomes.
  • Pothos – trailing, tells you when it's thirsty by drooping.

Keep them within about 2 m of the window and avoid overwatering — in low light, soil dries slowly.

title: Prompted Is pothos safe for cats?

safeHtmlItem.html:
No. Pothos contains calcium oxalate crystals and is toxic to cats: chewing it causes mouth irritation, drooling and vomiting.

Cat-safe alternatives for low light:

  1. Parlor palm
  2. Cast-iron plant
  3. Calathea (needs more humidity)
